scope: Exact NewYou platform browser wording for the seven FP-001 email-verification confirmation, verified and common-unavailable semantic keys. Approved for bounded development consumption after canonical integration; future real-participant use requires independently satisfied runtime and production-release gates.

en.text: Choose "Verify email" to confirm this address. Opening this page does not verify it.

af.text: Kies "Verifieer e-posadres" om hierdie adres te bevestig. As jy hierdie bladsy oopmaak, word dit nie geverifieer nie.

en.text: Your email address is verified. You have not been logged in.

af.text: Jou e-posadres is geverifieer. Jy is nie aangemeld nie.

en.text: This link cannot verify your email. Request another verification email from the registration page.

af.text: Hierdie skakel kan nie jou e-posadres verifieer nie. Vra nog ’n verifikasie-e-pos op die registrasiebladsy aan.

lifecycle_projection.business_authority: Identity & Access: opening confirmation is passive; only explicit CSRF-protected POST consumes proof
lifecycle_projection.success_guard: Only Identity.verify_email/1 returning {:ok, :verified} shows the verified result
lifecycle_projection.unavailable_guard: All other verification outcomes map to the common unavailable result; do not expose reasons
lifecycle_projection.retry_recovery: Revalidate current proof on every attempt; invalid, stale or replayed proofs cannot succeed

approval.source: Direct owner message in this conversation: supplied both corrected confirmation-body sentences, approved the remaining wording and explicitly authorised opening a PR.
approval.decision_actor: one accountable owner; do not imply multiple independent human approvals
approval.scope: seven fixed semantic keys, seven EN + seven AF exact UTF-8 strings
approval.development_scope: local development, automated tests and authorised development environments after exact canonical integration
approval.production_release_scope: NOT YET GRANTED; requires all applicable release and runtime eligibility proof

change_evidence.change_description: Wrap existing English and Afrikaans action labels in straight double quotation marks
